items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: But my ideas were from Lloyd.

ctx.x: Later years. But the force would come now. Now you see, I learned from Piku, George. But my ideas were from Lloyd. Now Big R. Louis was a man that played a clarinet. And he could take a clarinet and make a rooster, curl, dog bark, anything like that. And that's why I learned he told him that problem. Right on the end, because if he was playing the hill, I wouldn't dance or go out there. I wouldn't have to hang him or nothing from him.
Would you say he was your favorite of all the ones you heard?
